title: Create data exploration notebook helper
objective: A notebook-friendly helper module provides one-liner functions for fetching, inspecting, and visualizing bar data in Jupyter

functions.name: quick_fetch
functions.signature: (symbols: list[str], days_back: int = 5, timeframe: Timeframe = Timeframe.MINUTE_1) -> pd.DataFrame

functions.name: summarize
functions.returns: Summary stats per symbol: count, gaps, date range, completeness %

acceptance_criteria: quick_fetch creates provider from default config and returns DataFrame
check wraps quality.check_quality with sensible defaults
All functions have docstrings suitable for help() in notebook
notebooks/data_exploration.py is a valid Python script (percent format)
Test verifies summarize output shape and columns
Test verifies check returns QualityReport instance
validation: python -c "from orbust.data.notebook import quick_fetch, summarize, check"
